question: Does /Og keep source order for stores into a local struct? When a member's value is reused later (r.right = r.left + 9), MSC 6.00AX sinks the computation and store of r.left below the following member stores; computing it into a local first (a = ...; r.left = a; ... r.right = a + 9) keeps r.left first. Observed in S13 DrawColonyBars (worker resA: the original stores r.left first and keeps it in BX for r.right; the draft improved from 466 to 482 of 490 bytes with the local).

expect.member_reuse@0: mov word ptr [bp - 2], ax; sub ax, word ptr [bp + 0xa]; mov word ptr [bp - 6], ax; mov ax, word ptr [bp + 6]
expect.local_copy@0: sub ax, cx; mov word ptr [bp - 8], ax; mov es, word ptr [2]
